title: NSClientV3 Full sync fails when encounters non-sgv entries
body:
[Here](https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/issues/8090) is the discussion started in NS issue.
tl;dr
/entries/history api can return non-sgv records

This [line of code](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/dev/core/ns-sdk/src/main/java/info/nightscout/sdk/mapper/SvgMapper.kt#L17) results in null record when there is no sgv field in entry.

And [here](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/dev/core/ns-sdk/src/main/java/info/nightscout/sdk/NSAndroidClientImpl.kt#L125) all the nulls are filtered out 🙂

So when Full sync tries to iterate over entries it stops prematurely because it receives lower amount of records than it requested. But these records were filtered-out on NSClient side.
